description: This file contains unit tests for the EntityTagMatcherValueValidator class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers package. It tests validation logic for entity tag matchers, including acceptance of correct and incorrect strings, immutability, and null handling.

classes.name: EntityTagMatcherValueValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EntityTagMatcherValueValidator, verifying validation of entity tag matchers, immutability, and null handling.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes static test data before all tests, setting up a valid EntityTagMatcher string.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares mock HeaderDefinition and validator instance before each test.

methods.description: Tests that the EntityTagMatcherValueValidator class is immutable.

methods.description: Verifies that passing null as header definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Verifies that passing null as value throws DittoHeaderInvalidException with an appropriate message.

methods.description: Checks that the validator can validate EntityTagMatcher class types.
